title: CY50112: Enzymes In Organic Synthesis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisite: NilGeneral aspects of enzyme catalysed reactions; use of the
following classes of enzymes in organic synthesis: hydrolases, oxidoreductases,
aldolases and other C-C bond forming enzymes, glycosyl transferases, enzymes
catalyzing addition, elimination and group transfer reactions.Book: C. H.
Wong, and G. H. Whitesides, Enzymes in organic synthesis; Kurt Faber,
Biotransformations in Organic Chemistry.
